answer.rationale: Run a guarded SMB onboarding simplification test rather than matching the competitor’s price cut. Signup simplification improved SMB activation and qualified revenue, while shortened onboarding improved time-to-value and 30-day retention. Promotional pricing can acquire price-sensitive SMBs but materially harms retention, conflicting with the sustainable-revenue objective. Limit rollout and monitor activation, qualified revenue, churn, and retention because signup simplification was not replicated beyond SMB and previously showed a small retention decline.
